_comment: Which installer to use for each broker.
MetaQuotes hosts a build per broker at a predictable address, which is why
these are preferred over the brokers' own download pages: the pages move,
wrap the file in a landing page, or hand out a different build per region.
The generic MetaQuotes terminal will connect to most brokers by name, so
'default' is a working fallback rather than a placeholder. A broker-specific
build is still better where one exists -- it ships that broker's server list,
so the terminal finds the server without being told where to look.
To add a broker: find its installer under download.mql5.com or the broker's
CDN, add an entry here, and run make-template.sh <key>. Nothing else changes.
